name: saas-platform-teardown
title_zh: 拆开一个SaaS的网页·桌面·移动三端
tagline_zh: 拿到落地页就给你分平台功能清单、用户路径、技术栈、定价映射。不是泛泛而谈，连三端为何这样同步。
tagline_en: Paste a landing page, get per-platform feature lists, user journeys, stack, pricing maps, and why they sync the.
desc_en: This skill should be used when the user gives a SaaS product's landing page URL, homepage, or name and asks for a full teardown or deep-dive of how the product works across web, desktop, and mobile — including per-platform feature inventories and user journeys, tech stack, pricing/plan mapping, how the platforms integrate and sync (and the business logic behind those choices), hardware integration
why_zh: 多数拆解只停在首页截图。它按平台分别盘功能与路径，再串起同步机制和定价层级。
why_en: Most teardowns stop at screenshots. This one inventories features per platform, then links sync mechanics and pricing tiers into.
limit_zh: 只认 SaaS 产品的落地页 URL、官网或产品名；不处理未上线或需登录才能访问的私有产品。输出为结构化报告。
limit_en: Only for public SaaS landing pages/names. No login-walled or unreleased products. Output is a structured report—no visual critique, no stack.
title_en: Teardown a SaaS across web, desktop & mobile, sync logic.
